newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average gains more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average gains more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average resumed its climb Tuesday, gaining more than 50 points after overcoming a modest bout of profit-taking.
At 2:36 p.m. EDT, the Dow was up 50.17 points at 7,264.66, surpassing Monday's record close of 7,214.49 and activating the New York Stock Exchange's limit on program trading.
